why: A correction line. A negative quantity is refused unless the line says `allow_negative`, because in a budget it is a typo every time — and when it IS a correction it has to work, including through the pro-rata allocation (the correction's net is part of its category's weight). The second line's own margin_percent is 100.00 even though the line is negative: margin / net with both negative is positive, and that is correct — a credit of 120 with no cost behind it gives back 120 of margin.
